# Web Experience, Accessibility, and SEO

- Target WCAG 2.2 AA and "good" Core Web Vitals at the 75th percentile.
- Define keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, contrast, reduced-motion, form-error, authentication, and embedded-flow tests.
- Require an equivalent supported fallback when a third-party flow has a critical accessibility barrier.
- Use progressive enhancement, responsive design tokens/components, optimized media, semantic HTML, structured data, canonical URLs, sitemap, and robots controls.
- Preserve Jamula.net canonical behavior and test Jamula.com HTTPS/path/query redirects.
- Set page-weight, image/video, script, font, and interaction performance budgets.
- Treat accessibility and performance as phase gates, not post-launch polish.
